decisions.reason: Removing Big Blocks and changing the primary-mint allocation necessarily makes the FAQ's Big Block, ticket, pool, and founder-share statements stale.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’d like to remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $1 to me, making the split:
$15 buy, $5 to me, $5 to affiliate, $5 to block prize pool.

This improves my bottom line while having minimal effect on sales.
It also makes the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even split between me and every community member, together with everyone having an equal chance at the never-ending $500 prizes, seems consistent with the project’s ethos.

value_updates.buyer_earnings: Explain the instant $5 commission and Small Block prize tickets, while stating that any future governance-token allocation depends on FAMM succeeding and has no guarantee of success or value.
value_updates.referral_operation: Explain that each NFT mint number is its permanent referral code, successful referred mints award $5 plus a Small Block ticket, and no-referral mints allocate the commission and a Small Block ticket to a random existing NFT holder.

block_prizes.small_block: 5 × $500 approximately every 500 mint or secondary sales
block_prizes.pool_funding: Every sale continues funding the Small Block prize pool.

value_updates.prize_tickets: Explain that each successful referral awards one Small Block ticket, more tickets produce more chances to win, tickets expire after the applicable Small Block draw, and later referrals apply to subsequent Small Blocks.
value_updates.single_level_and_founder_share: Explain that referrals are single-level, source is verified on Basescan, and each $15 primary mint is allocated as $5 to the founder, $5 to the affiliate, and $5 to the Small Block prize pool.

decisions.reason: The revenue split and Big Block removal do not change fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, access, or its ability to hold commissions and remaining prizes.

The Small Block draw otherwise remains intact, but the statement that everyone has an equal chance could be rhetorical or could change the current affiliate eligibility and ticket-weighted winner rules.
The source does not change the Transak provider, accepted payment methods, conversion flow, wallet requirement, or current deferral.
The About page explicitly describes Big Block tickets and draws, so those references must be removed after the client removes Big Blocks.

process_copy.heading: Mint the ebook NFT
process_copy.body: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_copy.heading: Earn Through Referrals
process_copy.body: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided, the $5 and a Small Block ticket are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_copy.heading: Build Up Tickets
process_copy.body: Every referral also awards you a Small Block prize ticket for the current block. More referrals means more tickets and greater chances.

process_copy.heading: Enter the Prize Draws
process_copy.body: Small Block awards 5 × $500 every 500 sales. Sales include mint and secondary sales. Chainlink VRF selects winners randomly and fairly.

process_copy.heading: Receive Your Rewards
process_copy.body: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click.

decisions.reason: The fallback $5 commission allocation for mints without a referral code remains valid and is not changed by the new revenue split.
Big Block removal does not itself change Small Block tickets, but the equal-chance wording could conflict with the current rule that additional tickets increase winning probability.
The direct referral commission was already $5 with immediate automatic payment; the source confirms rather than changes that behavior.
The fixed $15 base-purchase allocation does not remove or alter the separately optional mint-page tipping behavior.
The candidate already has a complete message-195 MODIFY removing big_block_ticket_counter_visible, so no additional or edited Event is required.
This Requirement already concerns only Small Block ticket allocation when no referral code is used, which remains valid after Big Block removal.
Active Small Block tickets can still transfer with the NFT; removing the Big Block ticket type does not invalidate the candidate's generic active-ticket transfer rule.
